Add a version

Each save creates a separate version. Existing source files stay intact.

Your library, on your laptop.

  1. Extract the ZIP, then launch.

    Double-click START-FAZ.cmd. Keep its window open while you work. Use Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.

  2. Choose a folder.

    Click Connect folder and select an empty local folder, for example Documents\FAZ Library. Allow the browser to view and save files. Avoid OneDrive or other synced folders if you want local-only storage.

  3. Build your library.

    Create one indicator project. Open it to add named versions, a .pine file (or pasted source), and optional chart screenshots.

  4. Come back anytime.

    Launch again and click Reconnect last folder, or select the same folder. All projects load from disk. Copy the entire library folder to a USB drive for a backup.

Work in one tab at a time. If another tab changes this library, reconnect before saving. Browser folder permission may need to be granted again after restarting.

No internet, subscriptions or accounts are needed. The local launcher only serves the application to this laptop; the browser writes your library files directly.
